## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Direct evidence is separated from interpretation.
- [ ] Sources and retrieval dates are recorded.
- [ ] Licensing, terms, privacy, or volatility concerns are recorded when relevant.
- [ ] Limitations and remaining uncertainty are stated.
- [ ] A recommendation is connected to the named decision.
